name: Near and Far
description: A one-minute pause for noticing what is near and far, by hearing, or by touch and sight.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A short noticing pause of near, far and still things, on Guided Pause.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Use as many steps as you like.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Notice what each step suggests, by hearing, or by touch and sight. It moves on by itself.
Press Next to skip a step or Back to repeat one.
tips: Each step offers a sound or something to feel or see. Use whichever suits you, and skip any step that does not.
